items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: That was Roy, you were trying to Roy Elder and George Hudson stole the telegram.

ctx.x: We were after another trumpet player.

That was Roy, you were trying to Roy Elder and George Hudson stole the telegram. He didn't give it to Roy, he kept the telegram himself and came in Roy's place. That's why you were trying to get Roy Elder and you got Hudson instead.
